## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 18 captures during January 2021. Activity was completed as part of the routine primary care imaging service. The number of captures provides the basis for reviewing service throughput and identifying any operational issues that may require follow-up.

## Image quality

Of the 18 captures, 1 was ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.6 per cent. The ungradable image should be reviewed where possible to determine whether the issue arose during image capture, equipment use or another part of the local process. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be monitored and addressed.

## Grading

Grading identified 3 referable results. The median lag from image capture to grading was 1 day. Results requiring referral should continue to be managed through the appropriate clinical pathway, with local staff ensuring that relevant follow-up actions are recorded. The activity, image quality and grading measures should be reviewed by the site team as part of routine service monitoring.
